reason: A DSH rescue and diagnostic toolkit whose primary purpose is detecting broken profile compositions and recovering from startup-blocking plugin configuration issues through a CLI and optional in-app health UI.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 启动前诊断配置组合问题、备份和恢复配置，并在需要时停用导致故障的条目的救援工具。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness rescue toolkit that diagnoses broken profile compositions, backs up and restores configuration, and can disable problematic entries during recovery.

capabilities: Validates DSH profile compositions and detects duplicate IDs, invalid YAML, and disabled entries
Runs DSH configuration inspection through a standalone CLI
Backs up and restores profile configuration files
Automatically disables problematic configuration rows during recovery
Displays health status and rescue events in the DSH UI
Writes rescue events to a local JSONL log
